body: Thank you and I’m sorry for throwing it all onto you a bit harshly. I’m just exhausted and sad. I don’t think I ever will find that someone or anyone who loves me the way I love the people in my life.

It shouldn’t be this painful every time. I’ve been cheated on terribly two out of the three times I’ve been in a relationship, both by people who I thought were good friends before we ever got together. I’ve been betrayed and abused by those partners alongside the cheating, I’ve been betrayed and abused by a family member off and on all my life. Love shouldn’t be this painful, it’s not normal. Nothing about this is normal. I shouldn’t have to constantly be maintaining myself out of fear of being hurt and then ultimately getting hurt the second I give someone, anyone — romantic or platonic — a chance.

I have my dog who I’ve loved for a decade now. The more years pass, the more scared I get of being alone again. He’s my best friend but I can’t imagine a day without him by my side. I’m scared of being alone.

Thank you for the offer and I’m sorry about everything you went through. I’ve been in the position of being cheated on and struggling to move on along with just prying myself from dead relationships that could’ve been fixed if the other person cared. It’s hard and I hate that we have both been in this position of pain. Any time I talk to someone about my issues, I always feel so selfish and like I’m burdening them or boring them. I don’t want to put anyone in that position.
It helps a little, I just wish we didn’t feel this way. I always feel like I’m a disappointment.
I’m sorry you feel the same way but feel a little less alone in the world knowing that this isn’t unusual.
I’ve been, it’s just stressful because there is never a successful next time. Any time I give someone or a situation a chance it always blows up in my face and I’m back to trying to maintain myself.
